text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا

words.gloss_range: interrogative negative particle opening a rhetorical recognition demand

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negating jussive particle segment inside the opener

words.prose: {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:a-lam}}) opens with a negated question that functions as an assertive disclosure, not as a request for missing information. Its {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) governs only the perception verb that follows, while the sending clause remains the positive fact to be recognized. The compact opener also recalls the disclosure formula found at 14:19, 14:24, 22:63, and 105:1, so the ayah begins by arresting attention before exposing the hidden causal chain.

topics.headline: rhetorical disclosure opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word already presses recognition of the hidden sending rather than opening a neutral inquiry.
topics.reason: The guardrail grammar identifies the opener as an interrogative negative particle governing the following jussive perception verb, which supports the CRITICAL rows that treat the question as recognition pressure.

topics.headline: particle scope guardrail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the negation on seeing, not on the divine dispatch that the ayah asserts inside the embedded clause.
topics.reason: QAC treats the opener as a particle with jussive force; the database-like root association is not local lexical meaning, and the scope is confined to the following perception verb.

topics.headline: clipped attention threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opener as a compact stop-start threshold that launches the whole ayah as a disclosure scene.
topics.reason: The surface fuses interrogative and negating operators into one written word, and the cited formula parallels support treating the opener as a recognizable disclosure frame.

words.gloss_range: jussive second-person perception verb taking the whole asserted clause as its object
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, considering, and forming a view; local use selects recognition of disclosed causality, not display or mutual seeing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: interrogative negative opener governing the jussive perception verb
embedded assertion connector introducing the perceived content clause

words.prose: {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}) makes perception the gateway into the ayah: what is seen is the whole asserted fact introduced by {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}), not a single visible object. The shortened jussive form carries the force of {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:a-lam}}) inside the verb, while the second-person subject remains built into the form. The root range lets seeing become recognition and judgment, but the local grammar narrows it away from ostentation, causative showing, mutual visibility, or an intransitive reading. The formulaic pattern links this disclosure to 14:19, 14:24, 22:63, 105:1, 7:148, 19:77, and 21:30, where seeing exposes a reality that would otherwise be missed.

topics.headline: clausal object disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to see targets a whole divine-act proposition, not merely the devils or the disbelievers.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the following asserted clause as the complement of the perception verb, so the CRITICAL disclosure rows survive as the main local structure.

topics.headline: jussive addressee form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opener's pressure visible in the verb's shortened form and directed immediately at the addressed perceiver.
topics.reason: QAC marks the form as an apocopated jussive second-person masculine singular verb governed by the opener, and attachment evidence recognizes the subject as morphologically present.

topics.headline: epistemic seeing narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeing here means recognizing and accepting hidden causation, while neighboring root branches are held outside the local parse.
topics.reason: The root range supports perception, cognition, and judgment, but the local Form I jussive verb with a clausal complement excludes ostentation, causative showing, and mutual-visibility branches.

topics.headline: formula and viewpoint echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's viewpoint shift: the addressed perceiver is summoned to recognize what the disbelieving class itself does not see.
topics.reason: The cited parallels show the same recognition formula used for divine action and hidden realities, while the local syntax applies it to the dispatch mechanism in 19:83.

topics.headline: intransitive reading blocked
topics.blocking_evidence: Attachment evidence marks the following {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}) clause as the syntactically forced clausal complement of {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}).
topics.reason: The local verb is not free-standing because the asserted clause is its object; an intransitive reading would erase a forced attachment.

words.gloss_range: emphatic subordinating connector plus first-person plural pronoun, introducing the fact to be perceived
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}) is the hinge that makes the following divine dispatch the object of seeing. It joins subordination, emphatic assertion, and first-person divine agency before the verb arrives, then prepares the matching agency marker in {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}). The ayah therefore does not leave the sending to inference: the connector itself carries declared agency into the action clause.

topics.headline: embedded factual hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dispatch is the precise content to be recognized, not a separate sentence after the question.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the asserted clause the complement of the perception verb, and this connector begins that governed content.

topics.headline: declared divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine agency marked before the dispatch verb, preventing the satanic agents from appearing self-directed.
topics.reason: The pronoun suffix in the connector is grammatically present and corresponds to the first-person marker in the following verb, supporting the agency-continuity rows.

topics.headline: emphatic assertion weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the hinge as weighted assertion, so the question and the divine declaration cannot drift apart.
topics.reason: The connector's surface form and syntactic position reinforce the transition from rhetorical question into asserted divine action.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person divine dispatch, with the devils as object and the disbelievers as the governed target
words.root_gloss_range: sending, releasing, dispatching, and commissioning; local Form IV selects causative dispatch, with release imagery narrowed by object and target

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite plural object dispatched by the verb
targeting preposition governing the following class
definite disbelieving target class governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) supplies the disclosed fact as a completed divine dispatch. Its active first-person form keeps agency explicit, its object is {{ar:الشَّيَاطِينَ}} ({{tr:al-shayāṭīn}}), and its target is carried through {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) toward {{ar:الْكَافِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīn}}). The root's release and mission field survives as controlled commissioning, not loose motion: a completed dispatch sets loose a continuing incitement. The clustered r-s-l-n sounds carry released motion into closure, while the word pivots from prior warning into the completed causal disclosure that supports the anti-haste command at 19:84. The word also polarizes ordinary messenger language with satanic deployment, with pressure from 19:51, 22:52, 16:63, 17:69, 2:14, 6:112, 7:27, and 26:221-222.

topics.headline: completed divine dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disclosed mechanism is already accomplished by divine agency before its ongoing effects are named.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect active first-person plural verb, and attachment evidence places it as the predicate content of the asserted clause.

topics.headline: object target vector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a complete deployment vector: sender, sent object, target preposition, and affected class.
topics.reason: The devils are the syntactically forced direct object, and the target class is governed through the following preposition as complement of the dispatch verb.

topics.headline: release commissioning narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels release and purposive mission together, while local syntax keeps that image inside a targeted divine dispatch.
topics.reason: The broader root field can include release and flowing, but Form IV with an object and target narrows the local value to causative dispatch or commissioning.

topics.headline: messenger field inversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the unsettling inversion: a root familiar from messengers is used for deploying satanic agents under divine control.
topics.reason: The contextual profile places this form commonly with divine sending, while the local object makes the deployment satanic rather than prophetic.

topics.headline: sound and boundary motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the completed dispatch as a pivot from prior warning into the next prohibition of haste at 19:84.
topics.reason: The completed dispatch supports the following manner clause and the supplied boundary rows link the disclosure to the next ayah's response at 19:84.

words.gloss_range: definite plural concrete noun functioning as the deployed object of the sending verb
words.root_gloss_range: devil, adversarial rebel, and distanced/separated one; local use selects the known plural adversarial category as sent agents

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed dispatch verb that takes this noun as object

words.prose: {{ar:الشَّيَاطِينَ}} ({{tr:al-shayāṭīn}}) is not the grammatical sender; it is the definite plural object dispatched by {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}). The article presupposes a known adversarial category, while the plural can behave as a collective force when the later verb agrees in collective fashion. The root field of rebellious distance and separation remains active as evaluative identity, and the category can include human or jinn devils in principle as 6:112 shows, though this local word does not specify species. The ayah turns that known adversarial class into an instrument aimed at the disbelieving target, with echoes including 2:102, 7:27, 17:27, and 18:63.

topics.headline: definite deployed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the devils are a known adversarial class placed under divine dispatch rather than independent movers.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word the accusative object of the dispatch verb, and QAC marks it as a definite plural concrete noun.

topics.headline: collective agent grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees many adversarial agents functioning as one collective inciting force in the final clause.
topics.reason: The later imperfect verb can agree with the plural as a collective/non-rational plural, supporting the CRITICAL collective-force rows.

topics.headline: rebellious distance identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the agents' identity as distanced, rebellious opposition before their action is described.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports the adversarial and distanced identity field, while the local noun form makes that identity an entity category rather than a verb.

topics.headline: species scope narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the category functional and adversarial without forcing the local word to choose human or jinn species.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence at 6:112 shows the category can include human and jinn rebels, but the local ayah only requires the plural adversarial category as dispatched object.

topics.headline: satanic kufr deployment network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees satanic identity and disbelieving concealment joined here as deployed agent and pressured target.
topics.reason: The local object-target syntax supports the CRITICAL rows that map satanic agents onto the disbelieving target class, while cited parallels show the broader network without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the target over, upon, or against whom the dispatch is directed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed target class of the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the deployment hinge: it attaches the completed sending to the governed target {{ar:الْكَافِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīn}}). Its relational force can carry upon, against, and over, so the dispatch feels imposed on the target rather than merely sent toward them. The grammar narrows the attachment to the dispatch verb, while the following manner clause shows how that pressure is realized as ongoing incitement.

topics.headline: deployment target hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition turns the sending into a targeted deployment, not a vague release.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following noun the governed complement of this preposition and connects the prepositional phrase to the dispatch verb.

topics.headline: imposed over against relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the relation as hostile imposition on the disbelieving target, while grammar keeps it a prepositional link rather than an independent image.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry overlay, opposition, and supervision, but local syntax limits those senses to the dispatch-target relation.

topics.headline: manner clause pressure narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the target relation flows into the final incitement clause, without relocating the preposition's syntactic government.
topics.reason: Some CRITICAL rows test or imply attachment to the incitement verb, but the guardrail parse attaches the prepositional complement to the dispatch verb; the final clause still realizes the pressure on the same target.

topics.headline: compact relational surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a short particle carrying the ayah's turn from dispatch to target pressure.
topics.reason: The surface word is a pure preposition, so its payoff lies in the compact relational hinge it supplies between the verb and the target phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle governed by the preposition and resumed by the following object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, ingratitude, disbelief, and expiation branches; local use selects the active disbelieving/concealing class under pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following incitement verb whose suffix resumes the target class

words.prose: {{ar:الْكَافِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīn}}) names the target as a definite active-participle class: those presently characterized by covering or disbelief. It is governed by {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), then resumed by the suffix in {{ar:تَؤُزُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:taʾuzzuhum}}), so the ayah moves from named target to affected object without changing referent. The root's covering and ingratitude field gives the label active moral texture, while expiation and intensitive branches remain outside the local form. Its k-f-r consonant sequence adds cover-friction-release texture to the target label before that target is pulled into the agitated final clause. The surrounding echoes include 19:77, 13:30, 14:22, 2:14, and 7:27, where kufr, satanic relation, and recognition fields intersect.

topics.headline: governed target class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disbelievers as the governed target of the deployment, not merely a background group.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite plural active participle in genitive position, and attachment evidence makes it the complement of the target preposition.

topics.headline: pronoun resumed target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same target class from explicit noun into object suffix, closing the local action circuit.
topics.reason: The suffix on the following verb is the direct object of incitement and resumes this definite plural target.

topics.headline: active covering state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disbelief as an active ongoing covering condition, while nonlocal branches are not allowed to replace the participial label.
topics.reason: The active participle supports an ongoing state of covering or disbelief, while expiation and intensitive branches are lexical background rather than the selected local sense.

topics.headline: kufr satanic echo field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the target label joining prior kufr language to satanic incitement rather than standing as a generic group name.
topics.reason: The local ayah combines the target class with dispatched devils, and the cited parallels support this as a meaningful echo field without changing the local grammar.

topics.headline: fricative covering texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the target label as a textured covering word that prepares its resumption in the agitated final clause.
topics.reason: The surface and boundary rows add sound-texture and local movement from target phrase to incitement clause.

words.gloss_range: ongoing inciting, goading, or agitating verb with object suffix resuming the disbelievers
words.root_gloss_range: urging, driving, goading, seething, boiling, hissing, crackling, and stirring; local use selects forceful incitement mapped onto persons

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: target class resumed by the verb's object suffix
sent plural agents carried as the subject of the inciting action
same-root cognate accusative that intensifies the verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَؤُزُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:taʾuzzuhum}}) turns the completed dispatch into ongoing manner or result: the sent agents are driving the already named disbelievers. Its suffix resumes {{ar:الْكَافِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīn}}), while the subject is carried from {{ar:الشَّيَاطِينَ}} ({{tr:al-shayāṭīn}}), making a tight causal circuit. The rare root gives incitement a concrete body: goading, propulsion, boiling, seething, and internally escalating agitation rather than reasoned persuasion. Its doubled z gives that pressure a hissing, crackling texture, and its immediate pairing with {{ar:أَزًّا}} ({{tr:azzā}}) makes the final clause self-redoubling. The boundary rows link 19:83 back to adversarial opposition at 19:82 and forward to the anti-haste command at 19:84.

topics.headline: ongoing manner result clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the completed dispatch continuing as present inciting operation rather than ending at the act of sending.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the final verb phrase as a circumstantial or manner-result clause following the dispatch verb.

topics.headline: object suffix causal circuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the disbelieving target into the verb's suffix, where agitation and object are fused in one word.
topics.reason: The suffix is the syntactically forced direct object of the inciting verb and resumes the target class named earlier.

topics.headline: seething incitement lexeme
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the incitement as bodily agitation: prodding, propulsion, seething, and internal escalation.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports forceful urging and seething imagery, and the local object makes that pressure act on the disbelieving target.

topics.headline: rare root cognate intensification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a Quranically concentrated root immediately generates its own intensifier at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root as low-occurrence and the next word as a same-root cognate accusative, so rarity and intensification converge locally.

topics.headline: agitated sound closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doubled consonant and closing cluster as an acoustic version of the agitation being described.
topics.reason: The sound-form rows cohere with the lexical seething and crackling field and with the immediate same-root gerund.

topics.headline: boundary acceleration bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 19:83 concretizing the opposition of 19:82 and setting up the restraint against haste in 19:84.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the local closing on intensified agitation and with the next ayah's anti-haste response at 19:84.

words.gloss_range: indefinite cognate accusative verbal noun intensifying the preceding incitement verb
words.root_gloss_range: same rare root field of inciting, driving, seething, hissing, and crackling; local noun names and intensifies the verb's own action
words.prose: {{ar:أَزًّا}} ({{tr:azzā}}) is the verb's own action returned as an indefinite cognate accusative. It does not introduce a new participant; it makes the incitement itself grammatically present and intensified. Because it is bare and indefinite, the action is not sorted by type or counted by number; it remains open-ended in force. As the final word, it lands the ayah on the process of agitated driving. Its doubled z and tanwīn leave a compact hissing, crackling close, turning the rare root into both sound and grammar: the verb agitates, then the noun names that agitation as the closing pressure.

topics.headline: cognate accusative intensifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the inciting action turned into its own grammatical object, making the final pressure intensifying rather than additive.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as a same-root cognate accusative serving the preceding verb, so intensification is locally licensed.

topics.headline: indefinite unbounded force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final incitement is left unqualified, so its force is intensified without being bounded by type or count.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite and lacks a qualifier, adjective, kind marker, or numeral; this supports intensification rather than classification or counting.

topics.headline: final process landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close on the agitation process itself, not on the agents or the target.
topics.reason: The final position and gerund form make the action's quality the ayah's landing point.

topics.headline: audible seething closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final noun as compact seething and crackling, matching the semantic field it names.
topics.reason: The lexical sound-field and doubled consonant rows cohere with the final noun's function as the audible intensifier of incitement.

topics.headline: rare root self amplification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's entire local Quranic weight is concentrated in a verb-gerund pair that amplifies itself at closure.
topics.reason: The contextual profile gives the root as low-occurrence, and the local construction immediately pairs finite verb and same-root gerund.

baseline_models.mechanism: The alerting sight frame asks for reflective recognition of a layered causal chain: divine release, rebel intermediaries, truth-concealing recipients, and sustained boiling agitation.

activation_trace.role: The alerting-inquiry branch makes the opening a demand to recognize an otherwise hidden arrangement.
The alternate mapped deliberation branch adds reflective assessment without replacing the surface sense of seeing.
Release or dispatch, including letting loose against restraint, supplies the governing action.
The rebellious-agent branch identifies the dispatched intermediaries as active insubordinate forces.
Concealment of truth defines the recipient class by its active blockage rather than a neutral label.
Boiling that emits a hiss supplies sustained internal excitation and makes the cognate intensifier dynamically forceful.

changed_reading.after: The ayah discloses a governed allocation of agencies in which released rebel forces keep truth-concealing recipients in an intensified, boiling state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive dispatch, plural agents, the placement عَلَى, and the crowding branch of أزّ combine into recurring bands of pressure that narrow the target collective's room for independent movement.

activation_trace.role: Successive flocks or groups turn dispatch into repeated arrivals rather than one isolated intervention.
Deviation, crookedness, and severity give the arriving plural agents a directional pressure against the target.
Packing bodies together until space contracts supplies the social-spatial effect of the repeated pressure.

changed_reading.before: The action is a single episode of inward suggestion.
changed_reading.after: The action can be read as a recurrent pressure field: successive deviant forces are added over a collective until its behavioral space contracts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired sight prompts frame a local forensic arc: a truth-concealing speaker voices confidence in future wealth and offspring, his saying is recorded while its consequence is extended, and he comes alone; the focus prompt then exposes agitation behind such confident speech.

activation_trace.role: The first alerting sight prompt opens the case that the focus sight prompt later re-reads.
Saying as belief or position makes the boast a committed orientation, not only emitted words.
An extended term holds the speaker's consequence open through time while the claim remains recorded.
The solitary branch strips the boastful speaker of the wealth, offspring, and social reinforcement he projected.
The renewed alerting prompt shifts attention from the visible boast to its hidden pressure mechanism.
Boiling excitation supplies a possible pressure beneath the speaker's assured surface.

structural_cues: 19:77 أَفَرَءَيْتَ and 19:83 أَلَمْ تَرَ form paired sight prompts around the local sequence.
The run moves from projected wealth and offspring through recorded speech and extension to solitary arrival, then names demonic agitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired prompts and the sequence boast → inscription and extension → solitude → focus; I infer that 19:83 diagnoses pressure behind the boast, while the live alternative is that it generalizes beyond this speaker without explaining his speech specifically.

changed_reading.before: 19:83 gives a generic description of a class unrelated to the preceding boast.
changed_reading.after: 19:83 can function as the disclosure requested by 19:77: apparent self-assurance is re-read as speech produced within an unseen field of agitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extension before the focus and prohibition of haste plus counting after it place demonic agitation inside a measured interval: the targets are accelerated internally while their allotted time is lengthened and enumerated externally.

activation_trace.role: Lengthened time supplies the outer interval within which agitation operates.
Intensifying boil supplies the targets' urgent inner tempo.
Speeding and bringing forward names the haste explicitly refused to the addressee.
Exact enumeration supplies the controlled outer tempo opposed to agitation.
The later repeated enumeration confirms that the measured clock reaches individual accounting.

structural_cues: 19:79 نَمُدُّ ... مَدًّا, 19:83 تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا, and 19:84 نَعُدُّ ... عَدًّا align intensified verb-verbal-noun pairs.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extension, intensified agitation, refused haste, and repeated counting; I assign them an inner-clock versus outer-clock relation, while the live alternative is that the haste command addresses only the messenger and does not describe the targets' temporality.

changed_reading.after: أزّ marks subjective acceleration inside an objectively extended and exactly counted interval: pressure urges them forward without shortening the countdown.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adopted powers are intended to furnish reinforcement, then disavow worship and become an opposing force; the next ayah's demonic pressure occupies the relational space left by that reversal, turning sought patronage into hostile propulsion.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening and reinforcement name the benefit the adopted powers were meant to provide.
Disavowal and renunciation reverse the expected alliance from within.
Contrary opposition converts former supports into forces facing their clients.
Rebellious agents supply the active hostile force that follows the failed patronage.
Boiling agitation renders the reversed relation as active pressure rather than mere absence of help.

structural_cues: The purpose clause لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا reverses in the next ayah to وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا.
The tight sequence عِزًّا → ضِدًّا → أَزًّا and عَلَيْهِمْ → عَلَى binds desired support, opposition, and pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intended reinforcement, explicit disavowal and opposition, then pressure upon the same target class; I infer a reversal of outsourced patronage, while the live alternative is that the devils are a distinct group introduced after, not the transformed relation of the adopted powers.

changed_reading.before: The devils attack from a theme independent of the failed gods.
changed_reading.after: Their agitation can be read as the operational reversal of hoped-for honor: outsourced support returns as opposition and pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus release and pressure become the upstream motion in a paired transport scene: the guarded are gathered as a delegation toward the Merciful, while the criminals are driven in successive entry toward Hell.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch initiate directed movement before the two destination scenes.
Crowding pressure supplies propulsion on the target collective.
Driving a group together toward a destination supplies the first explicit transport pattern.
Arrival before one holding authority gives the guarded group's movement a received-delegation form.
Driving and expelling supply the coercive counterpart appropriate to the pressured class.
Successive entry turns the destination into the endpoint of a continuing driven flow.

structural_cues: 19:85 and 19:86 form parallel plural movements with opposed destinations: إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ and إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ.
The focus has dispatch عَلَى a class; the following pair makes class-level motion toward destinations explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch and pressure followed by matched gathering and driving scenes; I infer that the focus pressure is upstream propulsion toward the criminal route, while the live alternative is that 19:85-86 show only later outcomes rather than continuation of the same motion.

changed_reading.before: Demonic agitation has no spatial or process relation to the following gathering.
changed_reading.after: It can be carried as an early transport force: pressure already moves the covered class toward the coercive route later named as driving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus supplies boiling and crowding pressure; the later doctrinal utterance assigns offspring, and the text renders that claim as opening, splitting, falling, and resounding fracture. Agitated speech thus becomes a possible relay from hidden pressure to world-scale material stress.

activation_trace.role: Boiling with emitted hiss supplies stored excitation and an acoustic register.
Compression and loss of room supply the pressure side of the later fracture analogy.
Saying as a held doctrine makes the offspring claim the articulated output of an orientation.
A thing represented as generated from another supplies the asserted relation carrying the stress.
Opening and fissure give pressure its first material failure mode.
Splitting open extends the failure across the earth.
A disturbed fall accompanied by sound transfers fracture into mountain collapse.
Severe rumbling gives the collapse the amplified sound-register latent in the focus boil.

structural_cues: 19:88 states the claim, 19:90 uses مِنْهُ for the near-fracture, and 19:91 supplies أَن دَعَوْا as its explanation.
The material sequence descends from heavens opening to earth splitting to mountains falling with a verbal-noun intensifier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies claim → cosmic fracture and earlier supplies demonic agitation; I add the arrow agitation → doctrinal utterance and read the focus pressure as the precursor, while the live alternative is that the claim arises independently and only its consequence is specified.

changed_reading.before: The focus agitation is private temptation with no material scale.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as pressure that becomes articulated doctrine and, once voiced, is represented as stress capable of opening and collapsing the world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus packs plural agents against plural recipients, but exhaustive enumeration and solitary arrival later decompose that pressured collective into separately answerable persons.

activation_trace.role: Crowding until space contracts supplies the initial collective compaction.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning resolves the packed class without remainder.
Repeated counting makes the decomposition explicit and exact.
The solitary individual is the terminal unit produced from the formerly crowded plurality.

structural_cues: 19:83 uses plural agents, plural recipients, and a plural object pronoun; 19:94-95 move through totalizing pronouns to each one arriving alone.
The repeated cognate accusatives أَزًّا and عَدًّا mark opposite operations: compaction and enumeration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective crowding branches followed by exhaustive counting and solitary arrival; I infer a pack → decompose contrast, while the live alternative is that plurality and individuality are compatible emphases without a staged operation.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers remain an undifferentiated mass under pressure.
changed_reading.after: Demonic pressure may homogenize them behaviorally as a crowd, but the later count reverses that compression by resolving every member into solitary accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines material branches of cover, tether, boiling, and crowding into one analogy. It remains anchored in the focus roots and the construction عَلَى, but downstream prose should call it a pressure-vessel or cinching image, not an etymological definition of unbelief or devils.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies an enclosure around the recipient class.
A long tightly twisted tether supplies a cinching linkage laid over that enclosure.
Boiling and hiss supply rising excitation inside the image.
Packing until the place narrows supplies constriction from outside.

changed_reading.before: Temptation consists only of discrete persuasive messages.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the covered collective resembles a cinched pressure vessel: external packing and internal boiling jointly reduce the possibility of release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant Q-W-L packet mapping and links nonadjacent sound branches. It remains valid as an activation because the focus azz branch is explicitly acoustic and the endpoint asks whether any faint sound remains; render it only as a form-distant vibratory arc, not lexical equivalence or a proven causal chain.

activation_trace.role: The boiling hiss gives focus agitation an acoustic vibration.
The alternate mapped oscillation branch lets voiced doctrine act, exploratorily, as transmitted disturbance.
Severe rumbling amplifies the disturbance at the cosmic-collapse scene.
Auditory perception sets the final test for whether any signal survives.
A faint hidden sound is the minimal endpoint whose absence closes the acoustic arc.

changed_reading.before: Agitation, utterance, cosmic collapse, and vanished peoples are unrelated sound events.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sequence traces disturbance from demonic hiss through oscillating doctrine and cosmic rumble to the total absence of even a faint residual sound.

strongest_changes: The عِزًّا → ضِدًّا → أَزًّا chain recasts agitation as the reversal of hoped-for patronage into hostile pressure.
The مَدًّا → أَزًّا → عَدًّا sequence places subjective acceleration inside extended and enumerated time.
Collective crowding is later reversed by exhaustive counting into solitary accountability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a controlled pressure-and-transport mechanism rather than a loose temptation theme; packet-provided split mappings also preserved reflective R-W-Y and vibratory Q-L-L as contained, form-distant activations.
remaining_uncertainties: أَرْسَلْنَا supports release or letting loose, but whether downstream prose should stress authorization, permission, or simple dispatch remains open.
The paired sight prompts may diagnose the specific boastful speaker or may only move from one example to a broader class.
The pressure-vessel and acoustic arcs are branch-backed analogies; they should not replace the surface morphology or be stated as settled causation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Satan is told to provoke with his voice and mobilize forces against people, the closest expanded depiction of incitement in the Quran.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God limits Satan's authority over true servants, balancing the focus's divine sending with a stated boundary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Choosing Iblis and his descendants as protectors instead of God explains the perverse allegiance underlying the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Satan whispers to Adam with a promise of permanence and dominion, a concise instance of enticing false hope.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Satan has no authority over them except as a test revealing belief in the Hereafter, a central clarification of the focus's delegated relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The exception for God's chosen servants confirms that satanic influence is neither universal nor sovereign.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Turning from the Merciful's remembrance results in an attached devil companion, directly parallel to satanic pressure upon rejecters.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those companions bar people from the way while they think themselves guided, explaining the deceptive experience of the focus's target.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command not to let Satan divert people names the same active opposition in direct terms.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: After guidance becomes clear, Satan entices apostates and fills them with false hopes, a direct post-revelation pattern of incitement.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: No person can control harm, benefit, or the appointed term; this reinforces the focus's divinely governed timing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The threatened punishment has an appointed term even when people seek to hasten it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's deferment of human reckoning to an appointed term supports the focus's counted restraint.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The disbelievers are left until their promised day, a close discourse-level counterpart to not hastening them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: When a soul's appointed term arrives, it cannot be deferred, reinforcing the exactness of the count.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Obedience brings respite until an appointed term, while God's term cannot be delayed once it comes.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P5 (19:77-98) - False Support Reversing Into Pressure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Supports acquired for strength become opposing or coercive forces.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Alliance reverses like a legal counterparty, while agitation becomes boiling, crowd compression, rope pressure, and lunar accounting.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Incitement as boiling, crowding, and counted pressure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Remote agents are released to apply repeated pressure, compressing and agitating a group while its term is exactly counted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dispatch and release (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); rebellious remote agent (`quranic:root_000796:B004/m01`); distance and disconnection (`quranic:root_000796:B001/m01`); long tightening rope (`quranic:root_000796:B002/m01`); boiling with audible hiss (`quranic:root_000028:B002/m01`); bodies compressed into a crowded space (`quranic:root_000028:B003/m01`); lunar adjustment between months and years (`quranic:root_000028:B006/m01`); premature haste (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); recurring appointed count (`quranic:root_000989:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 19:83 (ر س ل, ش ط ن, ك ف ر, ء ز ز); 19:84 (ع ج ل, ع د د)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Incitement is active pressure rather than abstract temptation. Agents at a distance tighten, boil, and crowd the group, yet the delay is not disorder: lunar and recurring counts fix its limit and answer the command not to hurry.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme

error_profile.loses: İçsel kavrayışla görme olanağını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle değil, zihinsel veya içsel bir kavrayışla algılama bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göz işlevine benzetilen içsel algılama yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görüş, kanı ve düşünerek karar verme çekirdektir; bilme, sanma ve danışma yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın zihinsel yargı ile düşünme, danışma ve göz tanıklığına bağlı sanma kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir konu hakkında düşünüp zihinde bir görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturmaktır. Derinlemesine düşünme bu sonuca götüren süreçtir; danışma başka birinin yargısını isteme, belirli tümce yapılarıysa bilme ya da sanma değeridir.

facets.statement: Bir konu hakkında zihinde görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturma.
Bir görüşe ulaşmak için konuyu ağır ağır ve farklı yönleriyle düşünme.
Başka birinden görüş isteme veya belirli bir yapıda bilme ve sanma bildirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zihinsel görüş ve inancı ortaklaştırır; düşünerek görüşe varma, bir başkasına danışma ve belirli yapılardaki bilme ya da sanma değerleri bu eksenin bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açıkça uyuyan kişinin uykuda gördüğü şeyi ve bunun çoğulunu bildirir. Uyanıkken gözle görmek, zihinsel görüş ve düşü yorumlama bu kimliğin parçası değildir.

concept_map.definition: Uyuyan bir kişinin uyku sırasında gördüğü düş veya düş görüntüsüdür. Adın çoğul biçimi de aynı türden birden çok uyku deneyimini bildirir.

facets.statement: Uyku sırasında görülen düş veya görüntü.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı uyku sırasında görülen düş olarak tanımlar ve tekil adın birden çok düşü bildiren çoğul biçimini de kaydeder.
